Name: Common Sensor Warping Terms
Description: The Common Sensor Warping terms (CSWRPB) TRE accommodates the general case of a scanner when samples along a line of an image were not all imaged at the same time. For a framer, the CSWRPB TRE can model the effects of optical distortion in teh image, pair-wise rectifying it to aid in stereo viewing, or image stabilization. This TRE provides teh de-warping information needed to handle these situations. For products where time increases with increasing or decreasing column (sample) coordinates, contrasted with the usual case where time increases with row (line) coordinates, the CSWRPB TRE shall be populated with values that induce a 90 degree rotation so that the resultant first row (line) is associated with TIME_FIRST_LINE_IMAGE.

NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA.Name: Number of Sets of Warping Data
NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA.Description: This field contains the number of sets of warping data in this instance of the CSWRPB TRE. If the sensor is a scanner, there shall be one set of warping data.

SENSOR_TYPE.Name: Sensor Type
SENSOR_TYPE.Description: This field shall identify the type of sensor that collected the image.

WRP_INTERP.Name: Warping Interpolation Type
WRP_INTERP.Description: This field shall identify the type of warping interpolation between sets of corrections calculated by evaluating the warping polynomials, with a value of 0 for nearest neighbor and a value of 1 for linear.

FL_WARP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Focal Length Associated with the nth Set of Warping Data
FL_WARP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field shall identify the focal length associated with the nth set of warping data.

OFFSET_LINE<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Line Coordinate Normalization Offset
OFFSET_LINE<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the offset for normalization of the line coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

OFFSET_SAMP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Sample Coordinate Normalization Offset
OFFSET_SAMP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the offset for normalization of the sample coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

SCALE_LINE<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Sample Coordinate Normalization Offset
SCALE_LINE<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the scale for normalization of the line coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

SCALE_SAMP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Sample Coordinate Normalization Scale
SCALE_SAMP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the scale for normalization of the sample coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

OFFSET_LINE_WNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Unwarped Line Coordinate Normalization Offset
OFFSET_LINE_WNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the offset for normalization of the line coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

OFFSET_SAMP_WNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Unwarped Sample Coordinate Normalization Offset
OFFSET_SAMP_WNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the offset for normalization of the sample coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

SCALE_LINE_UNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Unwarped Line Coordinate Normalization Scale
SCALE_LINE_UNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the scale for normalization of the line coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

SCALE_SAMP_UNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Unwarped Sample Coordinate Normalization Scale
SCALE_SAMP_UNWRP<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the scale for normalization of the sample coordinate for the nth set of warping data.

LINE_POLY_ORDER_M1<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Order of the Line De-Warping Polynomial Term Associated with Line Dependency
LINE_POLY_ORDER_M1<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the order of the line de-warping polynomial term associated with line dependency for the nth set of warping data.

LINE_POLY_ORDER_M2<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Order of the Line De-Warping Polynomial Term Associated with Sample Dependency
LINE_POLY_ORDER_M2<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the order of the line de-warping polynomial term associated with sample dependency for the nth set of warping data.

SAMP_POLY_ORDER_N1<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Order of the Sample De-Warping Polynomial Term Associated with Line Dependency
SAMP_POLY_ORDER_N1<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the order of the sample de-warping polynomial term associated with line dependency for the nth set of warping data.

SAMP_POLY_ORDER_N2<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Name: Order of the Sample De-Warping Polynomial Term Associated with Sample Dependency
SAMP_POLY_ORDER_N2<NUM_SETS_WARP_DATA>.Description: This field contains the order of the sample de-warping polynomial term associated with sample dependency for the nth set of warping data.

ANJI<LINE_POLY_ORDER_M1<LINE_POLY_ORDER_.Name: Line De-Warping Polynomial Coefficient of Order (i,j)
ANJI<LINE_POLY_ORDER_M1<LINE_POLY_ORDER_.Description: This field contains the coefficient of (i,j) order for the line de-warping polynomial associated with the nth set of warping data.

BNJI<SAMP_POLY_ORDER_M1<SAMP_POLY_ORDER_.Name: Sample De-Warping Polynomial Coefficient of Order (i,j)
BNJI<SAMP_POLY_ORDER_M1<SAMP_POLY_ORDER_.Description: This field contains the coefficient of (i,j) order for the sample de-warping polynomial associated with the nth set of warping data.

RESERVED_LEN.Name: Length of Reserved Field
RESERVED_LEN.Description: This is the reserved field length. This field value shall be 00000.
